rationale: Computed using steady-state heat balance: R_hot = (R_20/1000)*(1+alpha*(T_max-20)); convection = h*C_v*max(v,0.05)^0.6*(T_max-T_amb); radiation = eps*sigma*pi*D*((T_max+273.15)^4-(T_amb+273.15)^4); solar = alpha_s*G_s*D; ampacity = sqrt(max(convection+radiation-solar,0)/R_hot). T_max=75°C, conductor D=22.4mm, R_20=0.118Ω/km, alpha=0.00403/C, eps=0.7, alpha_s=0.7, h=0.72. t01 has lowest ampacity (322.8A) due to high solar (850W/m2) and moderate wind (0.7m/s); scheduled current 520A exceeds it.
